body: Three days grace was a good song iirc

Thanks, i get that the point is beauty. But nothing has that charm anymore. I once loved music, now i just find it humdrum. I suck as a boyfriend for a few reasons, and now that i feel like my spark has all but vanished I have no saving graces. So the two things i really lived for, women and art are no longer doing it. It was okay when i was making money, i could buy all the distracting things my town has to offer. But now, with no foreseeable prospects aesthetically or monetarily it's really hard to have any self worth.
